title: Integration of Other Contract Objects
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

Contract (Billable

Service)

With the exception of move-in and move-out data, you can change, display and check all data in multiple contracts for a contract
account simultaneously, if none of these contracts have been terminated.

You can change the screen layout by configuring the tabstrips. For more information, see the move-in screen layout.

Integration of Other Contract Objects

In addition to the utilities contract, other contracts can be integrated into functions and processes in SAP S/4HANA Utilities. A
relevant contract object is the MOS contract. Other contract objects can also be integrated.

Integration requires the implementation of Business Add-Ins (BAdIs) intended for this purpose. For more information, see SAP
Note 3342499 rt.

Relevant Fields in the Contract

Use

Service Provider

The service provider in the contract determines who is the owner of the contract or billable service. During move-in, the technical
master data (installation) is linked with the business master data (contract). The service type in the installation tells the system
that entries are also required for the deregulation fields in the contract. This means that the Service Provider field in the contract
is a required field during move-in if theService Type field in the installation contains an entry.
